description: This file provides utility functions for safely handling file URLs, converting them to filesystem paths, and extracting basenames from media source URLs or paths. It includes functions to validate URLs, convert 'file://' URLs to local paths, and handle platform-specific path issues.

methods.name: function isLocalFileUrlHost(hostname: string): boolean { isLocalFileUrlHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is empty or 'localhost', used to determine if a URL host is local.

methods.name: function assertNoWindowsNetworkPath(filePath: string, label = "Path"): void { assertNoWindowsNetworkPath
methods.description: Ensures the provided file path does not use Windows network path syntax; throws an error if it does during Windows platform execution.

methods.name: export function safeFileURLToPath(fileUrl: string): string { safeFileURLToPath
methods.description: Converts a 'file://' URL to a local filesystem path, validating the URL and host, and preventing Windows network paths.

methods.name: function trySafeFileURLToPath(fileUrl: string): string | undefined { trySafeFileURLToPath
methods.description: Attempts to convert a 'file://' URL to a local path, returning undefined if conversion fails.

methods.name: export function basenameFromMediaSource(source?: string): string | undefined { basenameFromMediaSource
methods.description: Extracts the basename (filename) from a media source URL or path, supporting 'file://', 'http(s)://', or direct paths.
